status.en: 17 armed incidents reported in the past seven days, 31% more than the week before, most of them in Baghdad, Kirkuk and Erbil.
status.nb: 17 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, 31 prosent flere enn uken før, flest i Baghdad, Kirkuk og Erbil.

summary.en: Iraqi authorities condemned the deadly attack on a Greek Orthodox church in Jordan and arrested suspects, while Iraqi leaders blamed external agents for the incident. Iranian forces were accused of severe border violations and smuggling, and the Iraqi border with Saudi Arabia was declared fully secured. Pro-Iran factions in Iraq alleged US airspace violations amid a disarmament dispute, and US travel warnings against Iraq remain in effect. The prime minister pledged to place armed factions and weapons under state control by June 2027. 396 battle-related deaths were recorded in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Irakiske myndigheter fordømte det dødelige angrepet på en gresk-ortodoks kirke i Jordan og arresterte mistenkte, mens irakiske ledere la skylden på eksterne agenter for hendelsen. Iranske styrker ble anklaget for alvorlige grensebrudd og smugling, og grensen mellom Irak og Saudi-Arabia ble erklært fullt sikret. Pro-iranske fraksjoner i Irak hevdet at USA hadde brutt luftrommet i forbindelse med en avrustningskonflikt, og amerikanske reiseråd mot Irak er fortsatt i kraft. Statsministeren lovet å plassere væpnede fraksjoner og våpen under statlig kontroll innen juni 2027. 396 dødsfall knyttet til kamper ble registrert i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.extract: The Iraqi conflict is a series of violent events that began with the 2003 American-led invasion of Iraq and deposition of Iraqi dictator Saddam Hussein, followed by a series of conflicts including the protracted Iraq War (2003–2011), the Iraqi insurgency (2011–2013), the War in Iraq (2013–2017), and most recently, the small-scale Islamic State insurgency in 4 provinces located in Northern Iraq since 2017.
